lesson_text: A `gh api graphql` mutation that a gate relies on must have its response checked, not only its exit status: GraphQL can answer HTTP 200 with a top-level `errors` array, so request a field that proves the effect (here `pullRequest { autoMergeRequest }`) and treat anything else as a failure to retry. Retry a non-idempotent-looking mutation only after re-reading the state it changes.
